replacements.old: - name: Retain synthetic profile visual evidence
replacements.new:
- name: Validate exact maintenance target observation evidence
        id: archive-target-observation-evidence
        timeout-minutes: 1
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'maintenance' }}
        run: python3 scripts/test_archive_target_observation_ci_contract.py --validate-evidence
      - name: Retain validated maintenance target observation evidence
        timeout-minutes: 1
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'maintenance' && steps.archive-target-observation-evidence.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: archive-target-observation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            web/playwright-report/archive-target-observation-validated/archive-target-observation.json
            web/playwright-report/archive-target-observation-validated/archive-target-observation-1440.png
            web/playwright-report/archive-target-observation-validated/archive-target-observation-390.png
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retain synthetic profile visual evidence
